# `manufacturer` records

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from schemas/0.1/manufacturer.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

An embedded library copy (doc 07 §2.1, doc 05 §13.2): `$k`, `id` (the copy ID
`v5(NS_LIBCOPY, library ‖ item)`), `$v`, the copy metadata, then the item's own members.

`sha256` is taken over the canonical compact JSON of the item's own members, without `id` and the copy
metadata, so the copy's hash equals the published item's (EW-CORE-014).

Deserialisation reads the copy metadata itself and hands the remaining members to the item's own
deserialiser, so errors inside the item keep their paths (a flattened field would lose them).

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | `manufacturer` |
| File | `lib/manufacturers/<id>.json` |
| Rank | null |
| Status | implemented |
| Record version | 1 |
| Schema | [`manufacturer.schema.json`](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/schemas/0.1/manufacturer.schema.json) |

## Types

### Ident

An identifier: non-empty, one line (no control character U+0000 to U+001F or U+007F to U+009F), without leading or trailing white space (the Unicode White_Space set); interior spaces are allowed (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express Unicode Normalization Form C; the reader rejects non-NFC text.

Type: string (at least 1 character(s))

Pattern: `^[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000](?:[^\u0000-\u001F\u007F-\u009F]*[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000])?$`

### ItemMeta

Provenance of a library item (doc 07 §2.1, §2.5). The item's semantic version is the copy metadata
`version` of the `LibCopy` and is stored once, there.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `as_of` | [`Date`](#date) or `null` | no |  | Date of the data. |
| `confidence` | map of [`Confidence`](#confidence) | no |  | Confidence per section, keyed by section name. |
| `foreign_terms` | boolean | no |  | Imported content under foreign terms. |
| `key` | [`Ident`](#ident) or `null` | no |  | Human key (`pxc.2904602`, `ew.iec.mcb-1pn`). |
| `licence` | string or `null` | no |  | SPDX licence expression of the item. |
| `sources` | array of string | no |  | Where the data came from: datasheet references, file hashes, manual entry. |
| `status` | [`ItemStatus`](#itemstatus) | no |  | Item status; default released. |

### Confidence

Confidence of one section of library data.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"verified"` | Checked against a source. |
| `"unverified"` | Not yet checked. |
| `"test"` | Test data. |

### Date

An authored date YYYY-MM-DD (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (pattern `^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$`)

Pattern: `^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$`

### ItemStatus

Status of a library item.

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**: Draft.

   Shape: `"draft"`

2. **Form 2**: Released (the default).

   Shape: `"released"`

3. **Form 3**: Deprecated, with an optional successor: `{"deprecated": {"successor": …}}`.

   Shape: object { `deprecated`: [`Deprecation`](#deprecation) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `deprecated` | [`Deprecation`](#deprecation) | yes |  | The payload of `ItemStatus::Deprecated`. |

4. **Form 4**: Withdrawn.

   Shape: `"withdrawn"`

### Deprecation

The payload of `ItemStatus::Deprecated`.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `successor` | [`LibRef`](#libref) or `null` | no |  | The successor. |

### LibRef

A reference between library items (doc 07 §2.1): library, item and a semantic-version requirement.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `item` | [`Uuid`](#uuid) | yes |  | The item's UUID, stable across versions. |
| `library` | [`Uuid`](#uuid) | yes |  | The library's UUID. |
| `version_req` | string | yes |  | A semantic-version requirement such as `"^1"`. |

### MlText

Multilingual text: a neutral string, or an object keyed by canonical BCP 47 tags with non-empty string values (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express that all text is NFC or that the keys are in ascending byte order; the reader rejects both.

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**

   Shape: string

2. **Form 2**

   Shape: map of string (at least 1 character(s)) (at least 1 propert(ies))

### Sha256

A SHA-256 digest sha256:&lt;64 lower-case hex> (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (pattern `^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$`)

Pattern: `^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$`

### Uuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`
